name: Leapsome
summary: Leapsome prices each talent module separately and lists prices in euros only: Performance Reviews at 7 euros and Goals & OKRs at 4 euros per employee per month. Every module needs its HRIS platform, free at the Foundation tier during a promotion that ends December 31.

facts.text: Leapsome's review page says reviews can be triggered on recurring schedules with customizable rules and workflows.
Instant feedback and meetings are included in the HRIS Foundation and Pro tiers, with no separate price listed.
The pricing page shows the Foundation list price as 7 euros in one place and 5 euros in its calculator, so confirm the final figure with sales.
Leapsome lists Engagement Surveys at 4 euros per employee per month. The page shows euro prices only, with a 14-day free trial and SSO and encryption included.
Leapsome says its surveys can run across the company, leadership or specific teams, and that anonymity settings and anonymous conversations with respondents are part of the product.
